=================== docs/PRD.md
# Product requirements

## Product

Unknown. The repository is a structural Nx workspace; no product statement exists in any inventoried home (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/architecture/`). The unknown is preserved, not invented.

## Audience

Unknown. No audience statement exists in the repository.

## Platforms

Web-shaped Nx workspace only: `apps/web`, `apps/api` and `apps/admin` are structural project directories whose `project.json` files declare no runnable targets. Mobile: none.

## Constraints

- Private, unlicensed repository; non-Blade; no product remote, runtime or deployment.
- The existing Nx workspace (`nx.json`, `package.json`, six `project.json` files) is retained and linked, never reselected.
- Design registry: none selected.
- No dependency installation, lockfile or `node_modules` is introduced for apps that have no runnable targets.

## Non-goals

- Selecting or installing a runtime stack, test runner or build tooling for the structural apps.
- Replacing existing homes (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/architecture/boundaries.md`, `docs/architecture/workflow.md`, `emitted/repo-catalog.json`).

## Success signals

Unknown. No measurable signals are recorded in the repository.

## Brand

Unknown. Non-Blade; no brand values exist and none are invented.

## Decisions

| Date | Ruling | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-09-05 | `APPROVE GREENFIELD PLAN` accepted for the brownfield-audit proposal: six documentation homes, README catalog reconciliation (three added library rows, one approval-gated orphan removal), CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md pointer reduction, config-only `roadmap init --config` rebound to seven `none` gates with design-home pointers, and the copied README catalog checker. | Fills only missing, partial or stale homes; preserves present homes byte-identically; invents no runtime stack, dependency or test for a workspace without runnable targets. |
=================== docs/adr/0001-tech-stack.md
# ADR 0001: Technology stack

## Status

Accepted

## Date

2026-09-05

## Context

The repository is an existing npm-managed Nx workspace: `package.json` (`zeroh-shaped-fixture`, private) declares only `nx ^23.0.0` as a devDependency, with no lockfile and no installed `node_modules`; `nx.json` has empty `targetDefaults`; `apps/web`, `apps/api`, `apps/admin`, `packages/shared`, `packages/ui` and `packages/generators` each carry a `project.json` naming only `name`, `root` and `projectType`, with no targets. No framework configuration (`next.config.*`, `vite.config.*`, `app.json`, `android/`, `pubspec.yaml`) exists. The workspace is structural; no runtime, test runner or build tooling is present. Private, unlicensed, non-Blade, no mobile, no product remote or deployment.

## Options
| option | pros | cons | better when | component reuse | source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Retain the existing Nx workspace as-is | Preserves the evidenced structure and boundaries; invents no tooling | Apps stay non-runnable until a runtime is chosen | The repository is structural and the product runtime is undecided | Shared packages are already modelled as Nx libraries | `nx.json`, `package.json`, `apps/*/project.json`, `packages/*/project.json` |
| Select a runtime stack now via stack-decision | Enables runnable targets and real gates | Requires product facts that are unknown and would replace a proven existing choice | Product runtime requirements are known | Depends on the selected stack | not evidenced |

## Ruling

2026-09-05: Retain the existing Nx workspace. It is the proven evidenced choice; no runtime stack is selected because the repository provides no product facts and no runnable targets, and `stack-decision` is deferred until requirements exist.

## Consequences

- Positive: existing homes and boundaries are preserved; `docs/architecture.md` links them.
- Negative: every quality gate is declared absent (`none`) in `roadmap/roadmap.config.json` until tooling is actually installed and bound.

## Revisit when

A runtime is selected for any app, a lockfile or `node_modules` appears, or any `project.json` gains an executable target.
=================== docs/adr/0002-design-system.md
# ADR 0002: Design system

## Status

Accepted

## Date

2026-09-05

## Context

`apps/web/components.json` and `packages/ui/components.json` both declare `{"style":"new-york","tsx":true}` with no registries, base color, CSS variables or icon library. No token home, theme or design documentation exists (`tokens/`, `*theme*`, `docs/**/*design*` are all absent). The repository is non-Blade, so no zeroh-design sibling handoff applies. No brand values are known.

## Options
| option | pros | cons | better when | component reuse | source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Record the existing shadcn-style `components.json` evidence with registry none | Matches evidenced files; invents nothing | Leaves palette, fonts and registries undecided | Brand and product facts are unknown | Components remain source-owned in `packages/ui` | `apps/web/components.json`, `packages/ui/components.json` |
| Select a registry and token source now | Completes the design system | Requires brand inputs that do not exist | Brand values are supplied | Registry items compose locally | not evidenced |

## Ruling

2026-09-05: Record the existing `components.json` evidence (style `new-york`, `tsx`) as the design-system state; selected registry is none; no tokens or brand values are invented; neither `components.json` is edited.

For Blade, store pointers only; tokens are owned by zeroh-design. Not applicable: this repository is non-Blade.

## Consequences

- Positive: `docs/ux-canon.md` links real evidenced homes.
- Negative: visual language remains undecided until brand inputs are supplied.

## Revisit when

A registry, token source or brand input is approved, or either `components.json` changes.

# ADR 0001: Technology stack

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The repository is an existing npm-managed Nx workspace: `package.json` (`zeroh-shaped-fixture`, private) declares only `nx ^23.0.0` as a devDependency, with no lockfile and no installed `node_modules`; `nx.json` has empty `targetDefaults`; `apps/web`, `apps/api`, `apps/admin`, `packages/shared`, `packages/ui` and `packages/generators` each carry a `project.json` naming only `name`, `root` and `projectType`, with no targets.
